answers.question: List the points to watch for this company, with sources
answers.lead: Points to watch from Hindustan Unilever's filed documents. Showing 3 of 11 items. See all on the Points to watch tab.

rows: Promoters have pledged 0.54% of their holding (0.50% in the earlier disclosure).
The auditor's report names provisions and contingent liabilities relating to taxation, litigation and claims as a key audit matter (Notes 2, 9, 21 and 24 to the standalone financial statements).

The auditor's report lists statutory dues that are disputed and pending before appellate authorities, tribunals or courts: income tax, sales tax, excise duty, customs duty and service tax, for periods from 1979-80 to 2025-26.

answers.question: What did management say in the latest concall and annual report? List guidance, capex plans and risks
answers.lead: The latest filings on file for this company are results and investor presentations, not call transcripts, so this answer is from those and the annual report.

bullets.label: Guidance
bullets.text: Consolidated EBITDA margin to be within the current guided range of 22-24%. Focus on volume-led profit growth under the company's own strategy (results presentation, 28 Oct 2026).

bullets.label: Capex plans
bullets.text: Growth-led capex investment to step up from 2% to 3% of turnover, with capital to be deployed on bolt-on acquisitions (investor presentation, 9 Sep 2026).

bullets.label: Risks named
bullets.text: Commodity inflation is expected to continue in the short term (28 Oct 2026). The auditor's report names the estimates behind provisions and contingent liabilities for tax, litigation and claims as a key audit matter, because the judgement involved is high (annual report FY2025-26).

answers.question: Show sales, profit, margin and debt for the last 3 years
answers.lead: Consolidated figures for the years ended 31 March, in Rs crore.
notes: FY2026 profit includes Rs 4,407 crore from the ice cream business, which was demerged and is reported as discontinued operations. Without it, FY2026 profit after tax would be Rs 10,633 crore. FY2025 includes a loss of Rs 9 crore from the same business (Rs 10,658 crore without it). Exceptional items are included in both years, as reported. The margin row uses all profit.

Sales are revenue from operations. Profit after tax is the share of the owners of the company. Margin is profit after tax ÷ sales, calculated by RedixFi. Debt is borrowings plus lease liabilities. Reported figures, not adjusted.

FY2026 and FY2025 are as shown in the annual report for FY2025-26; FY2024 is as shown in the annual report for FY2024-25. That report showed FY2025 sales of Rs 63,121 crore, which differs from the Rs 61,328 crore in the later report.
At 31 March 2026 the debt figure is lease liabilities of Rs 1,478 crore and no borrowings.
